securityReview.notes: Pure computational fix inside a CPU-bound attention kernel. No filesystem, network, credential, or MCP-authority surface touched. The fixed function is reachable from 3 MCP tool call sites (neural-tools.ts, hooks-tools.ts, system-tools.ts) via getFlashAttention()/computeAttention(), all of which pass numeric embedding-derived vectors, not user-controlled strings or paths — the input surface is not attacker-influenced code paths in a way this fix changes. Net effect of the fix is a correctness improvement (was silently returning NaN, now returns a valid numeric result) for a previously-broken code range; this reduces exposure (NaN outputs propagating into downstream cosine-similarity / ranking logic previously) rather than adding any.
